period_note: DISCRETE quarterly figures (NOT cumulative-from-Jan-1) taken from NRB Commercial Bank's own retrospective "Quarterly Performance" disclosure table embedded in its FY2014 annual report (this is the BSEC-mandated 'variance between quarterly financial performance and annual financial statements' disclosure, worded slightly differently in most years' reports). Verified as discrete (not cumulative) because Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4 sums to the table's own 'Annual' column for every row, every year, to within rounding. Consolidated basis (FY2013-FY2019 tables in this dataset are consolidated per sources.json's documented basis break at FY2020). No balance-sheet snapshot is available for this interim date -- NRB Commercial Bank's own quarterly/interim statements archive at nrbcommercialbank.com/about/reports only goes back to FY2020; for FY2014 the annual report's retrospective table is the only source of any interim data, and it carries income-statement rows only, no balance sheet. The table's own printed column headers are corrupted by a PDF-extraction artifact ("Q1, 2014 / Q2, 2014 / Q3, 2013 / Q1, 2014" -- a duplicated 'Q1, 2014' label and a stray 'Q3, 2013' where 'Q3, 2014' and 'Q4, 2014' belong). Relabelled Q1-Q4 2014 here on the strength of an exact sum-check against the table's own 'Annual, 2014' column (e.g. Net Interest Income 109.87+49.93-7.95+71.96=223.81 vs printed Annual 223.82; Operating Profit 40.29+69.50+40.49+180.90=331.18, exact) -- the 4 values are unambiguous regardless of the label corruption.

line_items.original_metric_name: Non-Interest Income (bank's own definition -- bundles Investment Income; see period_note)
line_items.note: This is the bank's OWN retrospective-table definition of 'Non-Interest Income' = Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income combined -- i.e. it INCLUDES investment income, unlike the 'non_interest_income' field used elsewhere in this dataset's Q4/annual files (which excludes investment income). Verified against the FY2020-2025 real interim statements, where the components are itemised separately and sum to exactly this combined figure each quarter checked (e.g. FY2024 Q1: 427.71 commission + 111.68 other + 957.02 investment = 1496.41 = this table's own Non-Interest Income cell for Q1,2024).
